title: Verification-bind idempotency key omits the claim fence and root generation, so two owed binds can reuse one key with different intents
outcome: A verification_bind's idempotency key identifies exactly one bind intent: two owed binds whose requests differ never share a key, so the host never itself produces control_operation_idempotency_conflict.
acceptance: Verification-bind idempotency key omits the claim fence and root generation, so two owed binds can reuse one key with different intents is done
